SuiteInformation.Title: Ionity AI Edge
SuiteInformation.Description: The Ionity AI Edge profile measures on-device inference capability for CPUs without (or alongside) an NPU such as Hailo: Ionity IO-AI-MatMul in FP32 and INT8 plus established OpenBenchmarking.org inference tests - TensorFlow Lite MobileNet (float and quantised), ONNX Runtime ResNet50 INT8 / YOLOv4 / super-resolution, NCNN, MNN, Llama.cpp granite-3B and Whisper.cpp base. The upstream tests download their models and frameworks from OpenBenchmarking.org mirrors.
SuiteInformation.Maintainer: Johan Wilhelm van Antwerp - Ionity (Pty) Ltd
